A '''tectonic manipulation excavator''' was a deep [[Mining/Legends|mining]] machine used by [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]]. The [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Lin Konpost]] would compute the stress analyses for the machines.
